title: Moment of an independent tensor power
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $d,m$ be natural numbers, and let $g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. The expectation of the $m$th power of the product $\prod_{i=1}^d g(x_i)$ under $d$ independent samples from $p$ equals $\bigl(\mathbb E_{x\sim p}[g(x)^m]\bigr)^d$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
